what: On first open, behind the word ‹Loading› centered in a pale curtain, dots add one every .4s and then clear, repeating (0→1→2→3). Once the document and fonts arrive, .5s later the text pulls back once and vanishes over .9s (cubic-bezier(.36,0,.66,-.56)), and at 1.2s the curtain folds up from the bottom edge over 1.2s (height 100%→0, cubic-bezier(.7,-.01,.31,.85): slow start, fast, then a late finish). At 1.9s fx:done fires (triggers the first copy rise), and at 3.4s the curtain is hidden

options.text-at: When the text starts to fade out (s, after it is ready), default .5
options.at: Time when the curtain starts to lift (s), default 1.2
options.dur: Curtain lift duration (seconds), default 1.2 — 0 lifts immediately
options.beat: Interval at which one more dot is added (s), default .4
options.[data-fx-part=veil]: Collapsing panel (the element itself if none)
options.[data-fx-part=dots]: (if present) spot where dots grow — fills in 0 to 3 period characters

use:
Loading

— When all have cleared, fx:done (bubbles up to the document)
note: The original sets the same timetable on both font ready (document.fonts.ready) and window load, whichever comes first. The part sets it once, from whichever comes first.
